title: n8n
summary: A workflow automation platform with cloud and self-hosting paths and execution-based cloud pricing.

facts.label: Workflow
facts.value: Connects applications and APIs in customizable, low-code workflows; supports custom nodes and AI functionality.

facts.label: Deployment
facts.value: Official docs describe n8n Cloud and self-hosted installation options such as npm and Docker.

facts.label: License model
facts.value: Official documentation describes n8n as fair-code licensed; review the applicable license terms for the intended use.

prices.name: Starter (n8n Cloud)
prices.billing: Displayed monthly equivalent, billed annually; confirm applicable region and taxes at checkout.
prices.allowance: 2,500 workflow executions per month with unlimited steps.

sections.heading: Estimate complete workflow runs
paragraphs: The Cloud pricing page counts a workflow execution as one run regardless of the number of steps. Estimate schedule and event frequency first, then test retries and failure behavior with representative data.

sections.heading: Compare hosting responsibility
paragraphs: Cloud pricing and self-hosted deployment move different operating responsibilities to the buyer. Before choosing self-hosting, account for upgrades, backups, secrets, monitoring and the license terms that apply to the planned use.

verdict: Evaluate n8n when workflows need API-level flexibility or self-hosting is a requirement. Compare execution volume and operating ownership rather than counting workflow steps alone.
bestFor: Builders connecting APIs and applications who can estimate full workflow executions
notFor: Teams that have not checked the fair-code terms or cannot own the chosen hosting path
migration: Export representative workflows and credentials separately. Test node availability, error handling, schedules and secrets in a non-production instance before cutover.
gaps: Confirm license compatibility, current feature entitlement and exact regional checkout price before a business recommendation.
Self-hosting shifts infrastructure and security operations to the operator; no deployment test was performed for this profile.

changes.summary: Initial official-source draft; exact revision awaits owner review.
